plugins.name: idm-docs-plugin
plugins.description: Score and improve documentation against IDM documentation guidelines

skills.name: docs-audit
skills.description: Comprehensive documentation audit for IDM projects. Checks completeness against IDM standards, then applies diataxis, persona-check, and python-docstrings skills. Produces a unified report with strengths, weaknesses, and prioritized recommendations.

skills.name: diataxis
skills.description: Diataxis documentation framework guidance for writing, reviewing, or improving documentation following the four topic types (tutorials, how-to guides, reference, explanation) and TOC organization.

skills.name: persona-check
skills.description: Checks that project documentation is written appropriately for its target IDM personas (policy-maker, policy-influencer, model-user, model-extender, model-builder).

skills.name: python-docstrings
skills.description: Guidelines for writing Python docstrings. Covers Google-style format, MkDocs/Quarto cross-references, usage examples, and researcher workflow context.

plugins.name: idm-eng-plugin
plugins.description: Score and improve scientific research code quality, usability, and safety against IDM engineering quality tiers

skills.name: eng-quality-checker
skills.description: Scores a software project against IDM engineering quality tiers (1-3) across quality, usability, and safety metrics.

skills.name: eng-quality-fixer
skills.description: Reads recommendations from an engineering_score.md report and implements prioritized improvements to the project.
